title: 7-round AES-128: Altered differential: selected subkeys

target.description: Reduced 7-round AES-128 with whitening k_-1, final MixColumns omitted, and u_i=MC^-1(k_i). The matching stage uses nine subkey bytes; PhaseA also guesses four whitening bytes. Their association and independent master-key information are not quantified. Selected-subkey goal is distinct from master-key recovery.

setting.key_relation: One fixed standard AES schedule; no related-key oracle.
setting.key_population: General fixed key; no weak-key subset is specified.
setting.plaintext_model: Two active input bytes; structures of2^16 contain approximately2^31 eligible pairs. Four extra whitening bytes are involved in pair filtering.
assumptions: The four-round one-byte differential is modeled at2^-120; Observation5 enumerates middle states using an average S-box count.
Wrong-key multisets are modeled random. The journal's separate probability proof has documented count/max-probability issues.
Reported time is the online stage; preprocessing is explicit and key-independent. Partial-encryption conversion factors are author estimates.
PhaseA:2^96 table lookups; PhaseB:2^101 encryption equivalents. Their native units are not conflated.

time.note: Online stage only; complete-key headlines do not individually price the remaining-key search.

data.note: Expected pair collection and retained-table coverage under the source assumptions.

memory.note: Special-multiset table: approximately512 bits per entry.

preprocessing.note: Source base2^127×2^8×2^-3=2^132; retained-table factor2^-n. Canonicalization, sorting and auxiliary-table overheads are not fully itemized.

success.description: No numerical finite-budget success is supplied for this exact partial_key_recovery endpoint. Expected right-pair counts, table coverage and wrong-key rejection are distinct from complete-output success. The existing Observation5 average-to-uniform enumeration conflict remains. AppendixA.1 changes the eligible-pair structure to two active input bytes and reports2^105 data,2^72 post-filter pairs and2^24 subkey suggestions per pair. It does not give a separate final success rate. The original one-byte differential probability is not relabelled as the probability for the entire altered procedure.
